directive.quote: For valuable work, inspect the actual behavior and integrate the final correct implementation into the default branch using ordinary commits.

preserve: Authored CSS variables and semantic tokens use the same palette precedence in previews and applied themes.
Keep the current default theme and its display/inverse roles.
allowed_deltas: Replace duplicate preview token readers with the existing palette resolver.
Retain the previously uncommitted Rillet theme as an optional DATA record.
banned_substitutions: Do not replace the current default with a branch-era theme.
Do not deploy or alter the running app.

baseline.note: Consolidation of existing behavior, with no external visual reference or source-copy baseline.

proof.note: All seven screen-look test files passed, 28 tests; no live app appearance claim.
